notes.title: CheeseCube Beta update V0.9.9
notes.content:
Hey there CheeseFans,

The finish line for the game is in sight. The main focus now is polishing the game. The release will be soon! For now CheeseCube version 0.9.9 is live for the Beta testers. I would love to see some feedback. Wanna be part of the testers? Then join the discord with this link: https://discord.gg/kU6pKDssSU The new update contains:

[b]New Features:[/b]
- 10 new levels and skins
- skin menu updated
- new soundtrack
- Steam leaderboard added
- leaderboard menu
- audio added to the player
- bushes audio
- world record and highscore visable during level
- fireballs 
- tutorial pop ups in tutorial added
- a few new achievements
- secrets added

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
- sandblock audio
- score text no longer bounces
- level 2 less jank
- level 23 less jank
- restart in pause menu no longer goes to the main menu
- screenscale in tutorial
- achievements do now trigger instant
- achievement system updated

Yours Sincerely,
Cheesemaster Cheeseboi CheeseCube Dev

notes.title: CheeseCube Beta update V0.9.6
notes.content:
Hey there CheeseFans,

It has been 3 weeks since the Demo hit the live servers. We have got over a 100 players playing, which is very nice. CheeseCube version 0.9.6 is live now on the Beta. The update contains: 

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Rotating Objects
- Level completion UI
- Main menu and pause menu animations
- Skins updated
- Particles
- Discord rich presence (Able to see the current scene and score on discord)
- Player Obstacle hit animation 
- You can now see how much time you need for the next star after level completion
- You are now able to see when a skin is unlocked in a level (it is purple now, known bug)
- 3 new levels
- 4 new achievements
- New soundtrack

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] (So all of you know that I am not doing nothing)
- Some minor bugfixes, like skins that were not working and some bad code
- The skip button has disappeared in the turtorial
- Levels no longer starts at a minus time
- Star bug
- More tutorial stuff
- 2 achievements updated ("As high as a giraffe" and "I believe I can fly")
- Added steam stats (not visable yet)

Yours Sincerely,
Memelord and cheesemaster Cheeseboi CheeseCube Dev

notes.title: CheeseCube Beta update

- Level 16 stars added
- Level 17, 18, 19 & 20 added

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- When you restarted the game while pause was active then the game was still paused
- When you started the game you automatically got 3 achievements

- The timer version 4 xD
